cards.title: Format an imported user model
cards.explanation: Import the User type from your local models module without a runtime import. The model needs a string name property.

cards.title: Track retry attempts
cards.explanation: Keep a fixed retry limit and a mutable attempt counter.

cards.title: Validate an unknown string
cards.explanation: Narrow an unknown input before calling string methods.

cards.title: Build a greeting with a default
cards.explanation: Infer the default parameter type while documenting the returned string.

cards.title: Create a reusable prefix formatter
cards.explanation: Capture a prefix in a typed arrow function and pass it to map.

cards.title: Describe configurable notifications
cards.explanation: Keep a channel fixed through the typed reference and provide a retry default.

cards.title: Extend a stored record contract
cards.explanation: Reuse an identifier contract in a more specific user model.

cards.title: Name an application identifier
cards.explanation: Use aliases to document an application model; UserId remains structurally a string.

cards.title: Model a request outcome
cards.explanation: Use a discriminant to make successful and failed request states explicit.

cards.title: Check a record at an input boundary
cards.explanation: Check both the object and property type before claiming the Named contract.

cards.title: Read the first item without losing its type
cards.explanation: Preserve the element type and make an empty collection explicit in the return type.

cards.title: Filter and double even values
cards.explanation: Create a new array containing the doubled even values: 4 and 8.

cards.title: Return a labelled measurement pair
cards.explanation: Return two related values with named tuple positions and destructure them at the call site.

cards.title: Separate credentials from a public profile
cards.explanation: Omit a credential property from a new object and override a public field. This is a shallow projection.

cards.title: Sum positive values
cards.explanation: Skip nonpositive values while accumulating a total.

cards.title: Count repeated labels
cards.explanation: Increment a keyed count while defaulting absent entries to zero.

cards.title: Deduplicate task tags
cards.code:
const tags = ["bug", "urgent", "bug"];
const uniqueTags = [...new Set(tags)];
cards.explanation: Keep the first occurrence of each tag in insertion order.

cards.title: Load independent counts concurrently
cards.explanation: Start both independent operations before awaiting their combined results.

cards.title: Report a parsing failure safely
cards.explanation: Convert a caught value to a safe error message without assuming it is an Error.

cards.title: Encapsulate a counter
cards.explanation: Expose a method while keeping its backing state private to the TypeScript contract.

cards.title: Use a default for an absent profile name
cards.explanation: Read an optional field from an optional object and default only a nullish result.

cards.title: Describe a partial user update
cards.explanation: Allow updates to selected user fields while excluding the identifier from fresh patch literals.

cards.title: Read a property while preserving its type
cards.explanation: Constrain the key to real properties and retain the selected property type.

cards.title: Derive feature flags from configuration keys
cards.explanation: Turn configuration keys into a boolean feature-flag contract.

cards.title: Check a literal route table
cards.explanation: Check route values against a template literal pattern while retaining each literal path.

cards.title: Represent a task priority
cards.explanation: Use explicit string enum values for a task priority.

cards.title: React: count button clicks
cards.explanation: Use in a React .tsx file. The functional updater reads the latest state; React and its type definitions are required.

cards.title: React: restore the document title on cleanup
cards.explanation: Call this custom hook from a React component. It updates the browser title after commit and restores it on cleanup.

cards.title: Next.js: read a search query in a route
cards.explanation: Place in app/search/route.ts in a Next.js App Router project. It returns a JSON response for the q query parameter.

cards.title: Next.js: redirect a route to sign-in
cards.explanation: Place in an App Router route.ts. This is a route redirect, not authentication middleware or an authorization check.

cards.title: Vue: derive a filtered task list
cards.explanation: Use Vue refs for source values and computed for a derived list. In a component, these declarations normally belong in setup.

cards.title: Vue: watch a reactive search term
cards.explanation: Wait for the scheduled watcher, then stop it. Watchers created inside component setup are normally stopped when that component unmounts.

cards.title: Angular: derive a cart total
cards.explanation: Use writable signals for inputs and a computed signal for their total. Read signal values by calling them.

cards.title: Angular: inject a typed configuration value
cards.explanation: Create a provider and explicitly enter its injection context before calling inject. Destroy the manually created injector when finished.

cards.title: Express: validate and accept a JSON user
cards.explanation: Express 5 and Zod are required. Register the app with a server to accept requests; this example validates input before returning it.

cards.title: Express: send a safe error response
cards.explanation: Register four-argument error middleware after routes. Return a generic message and delegate when a response has already started.

cards.title: Zod: validate a signup payload
cards.explanation: Zod 4 validates and trims the runtime input before returning the inferred output type. Invalid input throws a ZodError.

cards.title: Zod: report a safe validation result
cards.explanation: Handle valid and invalid input without exceptions or exposing the complete error payload.

cards.title: Axios: fetch typed users with error handling
cards.explanation: Pass an absolute baseURL in Node. The response generic provides static typing only; validate untrusted data separately.

cards.title: Axios: create a user with cancellation
cards.explanation: Pass an AbortController signal so the caller can cancel the HTTP request. No request runs until this function is called.

cards.title: Lodash: group unique tasks by status
cards.explanation: Remove duplicate task IDs before grouping. Requires lodash and @types/lodash.

cards.title: Lodash: debounce a search callback
cards.explanation: Normally call search from an input handler. flush runs pending work immediately; cancel discards pending work during cleanup.

cards.title: date-fns: format a due date one week later
cards.explanation: Parse a local calendar date, add seven calendar days, and format it without mutating the original.

cards.title: date-fns: check a booking date range
cards.explanation: Test an inclusive interval and compute its span in calendar days rather than elapsed hours.

cards.title: RxJS: transform an observable sequence
cards.explanation: Collect a finite sequence into one array and unwrap its first emitted result.

cards.title: RxJS: switch to the latest search stream
cards.explanation: Replace the finite local inner stream with a cancellation-aware request observable in a real search UI.

cards.title: TanStack Query: load and display a todo count
cards.explanation: Use in .tsx with React and TanStack Query 5. The local loader is deterministic; replace it with a typed server loader in your app.

cards.title: TanStack Query: invalidate todos after a mutation
cards.explanation: Call this custom hook within a QueryClientProvider. A successful save marks matching todo queries stale and refetches active ones.

cards.title: Zustand: share a typed counter between components
cards.explanation: Use in a React .tsx file. Select count and action separately to avoid constructing an unstable result object.

cards.title: Zustand: subscribe to state outside React
cards.explanation: The vanilla store works without a component. Unsubscribe when the consumer no longer needs updates.

cards.title: Jest: check addition with a case table
cards.explanation: Run in a Jest test file with TypeScript transformation or after compiling it. Each row creates a separate test case.

cards.title: Jest: assert an asynchronous dependency call
cards.explanation: Await the asynchronous assertion and inspect the mock arguments with the Jest runner.

cards.title: Vitest: test valid and invalid schema input
cards.explanation: Run with Vitest and Zod 4 installed. Type-check separately because runtime test transformation does not enforce types.

cards.title: Vitest: mock a typed asynchronous loader
cards.explanation: Use the mock function inferred from its implementation and await its result assertion.
